title: Start the kit log
decision: The person chooses a private sign-out log for the team and asks the kit to begin setup.

title: Name the people in a loan
decision: The person settles the names borrower and booking steward, then parks the piece.

title: Carry on with an unchecked fact
decision: The person declines the outside check, accepts that the fact is unchecked and asks the kit to record that choice.

title: Build one ready piece
decision: The person asks the kit to build the overdue-days change, run checks and save it. They say not to merge it.

title: Keep extra requests out of the build

title: Merge after trying the preview
decision: The person confirms the preview looks right, then asks the kit to merge and put the change live.

title: Compare the live copy with main
decision: The person asks for a live check and asks whether the old version can be restored if the wording causes trouble.

title: Check the project records
decision: The person asks whether the records have drifted.

title: Return after a stopped session
decision: The person asks what needs attention before anything changes.
